summary: The build has been approved and is under way. We have your Botswana event dates (30 November to 3 December), your Cape Town dates, your logos, your company documents and your iPad details. Next we are confirming the plan for registration and getting your WhatsApp approval going, because it takes time.

phases.name: Guest registration
phases.description: The foundation and the form guests use to register, with their consent.

phases.name: Operations dashboard and messaging
phases.description: Your team's control view, plus SMS and WhatsApp messages to guests.
phases.target: Early November, about 3 weeks before the event

phases.name: Check-in on the day
phases.description: Scanning guests in, or finding them by name, on your own phones and iPad, working even without signal.
phases.target: Late November, at the dress rehearsal

whats_next: Confirm how guests will register for Botswana, so we put the right things first
Start the WhatsApp business approval (this has a waiting period outside our control), using your shuttle message wording
Keep building the guest list foundation

needs_from_you.item: Grant's list of the reports you need
needs_from_you.why: So the reports match how you actually work

updates.text: Received your iPad details, your company documents for the WhatsApp approval, your Cape Town shuttle list and the headings of your registration sheet. Thank you, this helps a great deal. For practice we will use a scrambled copy of the Cape Town list, so no real guest details are shared.
Cape Town dates received (14 to 19 November). We will use them for a quiet practice run alongside your own process.
Event dates received: Botswana, 30 November to 3 December, with accreditation on 1, 2 and 3 December. Logos received. Manual check-in by name, without a scan, is planned for the day.
Project approved. Planning complete and the build team is set up. Registration and event setup come first.

change_requests.title: Team photos in guest messages
change_requests.status: Noted for after the December event. In the meantime, messages will name the host (for example, "Your host today is Thandi").
